description:
1) 6 qualifying groups in total;
Stage Distribution to the Final Divisions A, D, E and B, C, F
Points are carried forward to the Final Division

2) Final Divisions A and B (24 players each - top 8 players of each qualifying group advances further) 
Division 2 - places 9th-11th
Division 3 - the remaining players

3) Final division Play-offs (best of 7). Top 8 players from each final division advance further (16 in total)
Play-offs Div2, Div3 - best of 5 format, top 4 of each bottom division play.
